scale_ratio_note: Scale ratio = path_length(estimated) / path_length(GT). This is a path-length ratio, NOT a formal metric-scale estimate. A value near 1.0 indicates similar total displacement magnitude, not that the trajectory shape is correct.
temporal_split_note: The 70/30 split is a chronologically held-out temporal segment from the same MH_01_easy sequence. It is NOT an unseen-flight test.
ate_type: RAW ATE (no SE3/Sim3 alignment applied to primary metrics)
